description: Stdin that is not a JSON object (truncated JSON, an array, the literal null, an empty body) produces nothing, and javi hook still exits 0 with empty stdout.
contract: ADR-0016 §2 "Hooks are synchronous, so javi hook keeps its contract: spool the event, start a detached flush, exit 0 with empty stdout"; ADR-0010 Neutral hooks ("prints nothing and exits 0 in every case (bad input ...)"); hooks reference: Global hook mechanics (exit codes, "Silence is Mandatory")
